prompt_input:
参考图1为[萧景琰-基础形象]的角色四视图。

【剧情】
【0 s - 5 s】中景，平视机位。画面采用地牢幽暗烛光，呈现冷峻压抑的玄青色氛围，具有细腻写实电影质感。承接上一镜旧仆挑衅的落点，@图片1(萧景琰)伫立在铁栏前，双手紧紧捏住血书-基础形象，指节因用力而泛白，目光阴冷如冰。镜头缓慢推进至中近景，聚焦在@图片1(萧景琰)冷峻的脸部与手中紧握的血书-基础形象，@图片1(萧景琰)沉声说道：“药王谷的账，本王一笔笔算。”镜头停留在@图片1(萧景琰)目光锁定前方的状态。
【5 s - 10 s】中近景，略微俯拍机位。承接@图片1(萧景琰)宣告的视线方向，镜头切至铁栏内 侯府旧仆-基础形象 的视角，@图片1(萧景琰)手腕猛地向下一甩，血书-基础形象 精准砸在 侯府旧仆-基础形象 的脚边。侯府旧仆-基础形象 眼神剧烈一颤，视线扫过地上的 血书-基础形象，随即紧紧咬住牙关，猛地闭眼不再出声。镜头缓推至 侯府旧仆-基础形象 紧闭的双眼，落在其上。
【10 s - 15 s】近景，平视机位。承接 侯府旧仆-基础形象 闭目防御的状态，镜头拉回至 @图片1(萧景琰) 侧面，@图片1(萧景琰) 俯身凑近铁栏，压低声音向铁栏内逼问：“药王谷要重夺京城命脉，你敢做我弃卒？” @图片1(萧景琰) 身体前倾的姿态形成压迫感，镜头落在 @图片1(萧景琰) 嘴角微动的冷厉瞬间。

视频全程不要字幕、不要屏幕文字；必须保留协调统一的全局BGM和必要环境音，禁止静音段。

Visual style: 采用低明度黑金电影风，融合东方古典审美、高级时尚摄影与细腻写实质感。整体使用墨黑、玄青、暗金和少量深酒红，明暗清晰，金色精致克制，带有柔和高光、自然暗部层次与细腻胶片颗粒。所有色彩、纹理和光影效果仅作用于当前生成目标，不向画布空白区域扩散。用户明确指定的资产外观优先；以下规则仅作用于当前生成目标，未涉及的资产类型不得主动添加。
【整体画面风格】
低明度黑金电影质感，墨黑、玄青、暗金与少量深酒红形成统一色彩。高光柔和克制，暗部通透，中间调丰富，金色反射清晰但不过曝。画面具有自然高光滚降、细腻暗部层次、轻微胶片颗粒和真实镜头柔度。
所有暗色、颗粒和明暗塑造仅附着于当前生成目标；画布空白区域保持原始颜色、均匀洁净，无纹理、烟雾、暗角和投影扩散。避免惨白色调、廉价金色、鲜艳霓虹、死黑、油亮塑料感、仙侠游戏特效、欧美哥特感和影楼写真感。
Segment visual style: 画面采用地牢幽暗烛光，呈现冷峻压抑的玄青色氛围，具有细腻写实电影质感。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is 萧景琰, the prince whose identity comes from <Picture 1>: handsome young East Asian man with sharp brows and a cold composed expression, long black hair in a high ponytail secured with an ornate dark-gold metal crown and hairpin, long gold tassel earrings, black round-collar historical Chinese robe with subtle dark tonal embroidery, white inner collar with a deep wine-red under-collar layer, black leather belt with dark-gold buckle and hanging green jade pendant, black boots. His face, hairstyle, crown, robe, belt, and jade pendant must be preserved exactly.
<Subject 2> is 侯府旧仆, the old household servant imprisoned inside the iron bars: a disheveled, gaunt older man rendered consistently with the dungeon's xuan-cyan candlelit palette, fearful then defiantly silent.
<Subject 3> is the blood letter (血书-基础形象): a crumpled paper document written in blood, gripped in 萧景琰's whitening knuckles and later hurled to land at the servant's feet.
<Subject 4> is the dungeon environment: iron bars, rough stone floor and walls, and flickering candlelight creating a cold, oppressive xuan-cyan atmosphere.

detailed_description:
The target video is a 12-second dungeon interrogation in low-key black-gold cinematic style: ink-black, xuan-cyan, dark gold, and a touch of deep wine red; flickering dungeon candlelight, soft restrained highlights, transparent shadow layers, and subtle film grain. No subtitles or on-screen text appear at any point.
[Shot 1] A medium shot at eye level opens on <Subject 4>, the dungeon with iron bars and rough stone washed in cold xuan-cyan candlelight, candle flames trembling on the walls. <Subject 1> 萧景琰, exactly per <Picture 1> — black embroidered robe, wine-red under-collar, dark-gold hair crown, gold tassel earrings, green jade pendant — stands before the bars, both hands tightly gripping <Subject 3>, the crumpled blood letter, his knuckles whitening with pressure, his gaze icy. The camera pushes in slowly to a medium-close framing on his cold face and the blood-stained document in his hands. He speaks in a low, heavy voice, <d>[Chinese] 药王谷的账，本王一笔笔算。</d> The shot holds on his locked, forward stare as candlelight flickers across his features.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a medium-close framing with a slight high angle, from inside the bars over <Subject 2>, the disheveled gaunt old servant crouched on the stone floor. <Subject 1>'s wrist snaps downward at the top of frame and <Subject 3>, the blood letter, strikes the ground precisely at the servant's feet with a sharp slap on stone. The servant's eyes shudder violently; his gaze sweeps down across the blood-soaked paper, then he grits his teeth and squeezes his eyes shut hard, refusing to speak. The camera pushes slowly onto his tightly closed eyes, candle shadows quivering over his hollow face.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a close-up at eye level on <Subject 1> from the side. He bends toward the iron bars, leaning in with an oppressive forward posture, the dark-gold crown and tassel earring catching thin candlelight as he presses his interrogation in a lowered, pressing voice, <d>[Chinese] 药王谷要重夺京城命脉，你敢做我弃卒？</d> The shot lands on the cold, ruthless micro-movement at the corner of his mouth, held to the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous diegetic dungeon ambience throughout: flickering candle crackle, faint echoes of distant chains, cold stone room tone, the sharp slap of the blood letter hitting stone at ~00:04.500, and 萧景琰's low close-up voice. No silent segments.

non_diegetic_music:
A continuous, unified non-diegetic BGM runs the full 12 seconds without gaps: cold, tense low-register strings and sparse percussion with an Eastern classical color, sustaining a dark oppressive pulse that subtly tightens through the throw and the final interrogation.
